scenarios.title: Supplier research
preconditions: no real external communications or financial side effects
scenarios.acceptance: Given supplier specification and three fixture websites, output a sourced comparison table with normalized units, unknowns and no outbound messages.

scenarios.title: Costing workbook
preconditions: no real external communications or financial side effects
scenarios.acceptance: Given a fixture bill of materials, produce XLSX with three editable scenarios, verified formulas and reconciled totals.

scenarios.title: Preserving document edits
preconditions: no real external communications or financial side effects
scenarios.acceptance: Given a versioned document fixture, produce modified copy and diff without losing untouched clauses and formatting.

scenarios.title: Memory project continuity
preconditions: no real external communications or financial side effects
scenarios.acceptance: After restart, retrieve a sourced latest decision with previous superseded decision; no unrelated project leakage.
scenarios.verification_scope: Scoped synthetic runtime evidence; live Qwen planning/final responses with owner/test-harness injected revision. No live model-generated revision certification. See m1-review-fixes.md for remaining M1 gates.

preconditions: no real external communications or financial side effects

preconditions: no real external communications or financial side effects
